## Change

Describe the behavior and why it belongs in the current milestone.

## Correctness and compatibility

Describe transaction, durability, format or schema effects. Note recovery after failure and any changed limits.

## Verification

Record the actual commands/checks run, failing regression reproduced, and relevant examples/benchmarks. Distinguish measured results from expectations.

- [ ] Tests cover new behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation describes implemented behavior and remaining limits.
- [ ] No implicit format conversion, unsafe cleanup or weakened durability.
